Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
i've just opened my third box of SW boosters and have now looked through
all the precons. No new cards to report, and so i'm thinking we must be
close to, if not actually at, a full list. Thanks to all who have helped
with this and especially Ethan and Petri who did most of the work, and
Adam and Markus and anybody else i've forgotten who chipped in. If i have
missed anything please let me know. It is even possible that we are OVER
the full list, and that there are cards written below that aren't
actually in the set. That's a clumsy way of saying that i personally do
not necessarily yet have all the cards on the list below, so i would
appreciate people who suspect that there are cards on the list that
shouldn't be there letting me know about that as well. If i get round to
ordering my collection this evening or over the weekend i will write
another post about any cards that seem to be missing.

.44 Magnum

Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
"pallando" <pall...@gmx.at> wrote in message
news:X8AM5.14138$Le2.6...@news.chello.at...

> after gong through 4 boxes i could not find the following:

Hmm. Interesting distribution. Though I think I'm missing more than you
still (didn't go through 4 boxes...), I note that you've got confirmation on
all of the !Malk/Dementation cards, of which I saw very few.

> ablative skin

Exists. I still think it sucks, though.

> bauble

Haven't seen it yet.

> disarm

Yes. It's in there. Thank god.

> enchanted marionette

I've got two. Anyone want one?

> fire in the blood

Bleah. Yes, I've got it in front of me. Well, not really. It's on my
kitchen table, and I'm in front of the computer. But it's within 50 feet.
More like 30. This is another one that I would question, a la Twisting the
Knife, and Up Yours! Up Yours would be interesting if it destroyed the
equipment as well...at a higher cost. As is, most weapons only cost 2 or
3...not at all worth it, IMNSHO.

> ghouled street thug

Yes. One of these days, I'm going to have to play with a bunch of the allies
that say "any cost in life...if a card would give blood..." and use a lot of
Taste of Vitae. Think I could get Akhentanen up to about 15 life?

> hand of conrad

Yes.

> intimidation

Yup. It's pretty nifty, eh?

> masochism

Yes. I could do with more of these as well.

> orgy of blood

Yes. Boring.

> political antagonist

I actually did not see this.

> tomb of ramesses III

Yes. I got two, for some god-forsaken reason, the worst part of it being that
I just recently got two in some Ancient Hearts boosters. Hey, Peter, I don't
suppose you want a ToRIII for the Behind You you gave me ages ago? (Didn't
think so...)

(Trading note to Pallando: I attempted to respond to your email, but they
were returned with errors. The Derange has been spoken for, but I may have
some of the other cards you're looking for. I'll try again later.)

Xian

> Taste of Vitae. Think I could get Akhentanen up to about 15 life?

Since it doesn't require a discipline, it doesn't qualify to be played by
an ally who can play cards that require <D> as a vampire, either.
